"""Billing transaction message emitter."""
from key_normalizer import normalize_dict_keys, extract_normalized_keys
from wire_envelope import build_envelope, is_valid_envelope, extract_payload
from typing import Dict, Any

def emit_billing_record(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int, service_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Emit billing transaction message for downstream consumers."""
    normalized_data = normalize_dict_keys(data)
    return build_envelope(service_name, epoch_ms, normalized_data)

def broadcast_billing_event(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int, service_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    record = emit_billing_record(data, epoch_ms, service_name)
    if is_valid_envelope(record):
        payload = extract_payload(record)
        _ = extract_normalized_keys(payload)
        return payload
    return {}
